samples: Ann and Tom are in London.
The day is done, and the night is here.
We wait, and the train is late.
The wind is cold, so shut the window.
Wood for the fire, water for the tea.
It's cold, so don't go out.
We can't wait, and we won't.
Mother's at home, father's at the mine.
The boy was born by the bay.
Papa had put the pipe by the bed.
Keep the key in the lock.
The dark road leads to the lake.
Jack joined the crew, and Jane joined too.
The job is done, so enjoy the evening.
Jim jumped the fence, and the dog followed.
The axle is fixed, so we can go.
Here is the list: iron, coal, stone.
The day is done; the night is near.
The book (an old one) is on the shelf.
Be quick, be quiet, be careful.
The zinc is in the bronze.
The puzzle has a dozen pieces.
The smelter never sleeps. It eats ore and gives back bronze, and so it goes all day.
Dear Ann, I am writing from Leeds. It is cold here, but the work goes on. Love, Sam.
There are 25 men in the crew.
We need 3 tons of coal and 2 of quartz.
It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife. (Austen)
An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue.
They say the crane once lifted itself. That is a joke, of course; but ever since, its plaque has read: "Do not test!"
In 1812 Dickens was born, and the English novel changed.
House 7 (by the river) sold for 1 250 000 pounds; the owner's pleased.
The engineer writes: "The system is simple (almost)". Input: ore; output: pages.
Two roads diverged in a yellow wood, And sorry I could not travel both, And be one traveler, long I stood. (Frost)
Dear Mr Hudson, Thank you for your letter of 12 May. My answers, point by point: 1) yes; 2) no; 3) we can talk it over when we meet.
"Who is there?" "It is me, the postman." "What have you brought?" "A letter from home."
Loch Ness holds more water than every lake in England and Wales put together: about 7 452 million cubic metres.
Hamlet. To be, or not to be, that is the question: whether it is nobler in the mind to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune. (Shakespeare)
The frontier has one exam: build the machine, start it (at 6:00) and go to bed. If it is running in the morning, you are a master.
Speed is distance divided by time. If the distance is 120 miles and the time is 2 hours, the speed is 60 miles an hour.
Tyger Tyger, burning bright, In the forests of the night; What immortal hand or eye, Could frame thy fearful symmetry? (Blake)
Hello! Order 4085 (3 items; 12 700 pounds) was sent on 8 June; the tracking number is attached. Regards, the warehouse.
"Curiouser and curiouser!" cried Alice; "now I am opening out like the largest telescope that ever was!" (Carroll)
The area of a circle is pi times the radius squared. With a radius of 3 (cm) the area is about 28.3 (sq cm).
In 1928 the Flying Scotsman ran the 392 miles from London to Edinburgh without a stop: 8 hours, 3 minutes, 1 engine.
Algorithm: 1) read a number; 2) if it is even, halve it, else triple it and add 1; 3) repeat until you reach 1.
Formula: (x + y) * (x - y) = x^2 - y^2; with x = 7, y = 3 we get 40 (100% correct).
if (n % 2 === 0) { print(`${n} is even`); } else { print(`odd`); } // n: 0..10
